reference: kemiller2002/limen#28 (LCP-018); docs/requirements/LIMEN-INDEXEDDB-REQUIREMENTS.md LCP-076; OQ-LIMEN-IDB-006 (accepted: Playwright WebKit in CI plus a manual iPad Safari checklist per release)
placement: Guardrail / Tooling. The packs smoke runner gains a WebKit mode (npm run smoke:packs:webkit): Playwright WebKit, the same strict CSP, evaluation without the DevTools protocol, and only the pages whose page.json lists webkit (the store pages). CI gains a job that runs it and fails if it fails, and the required CI gates include it. WebKit-only skips are named checks that link their evidence. Trusted Types is not enforced in WebKit and the run says so. No pack behaviour changes.

expansions.reason: The first WebKit run found that WebKit reports blocked while the pack's own just-closed connection still has its schema-read transaction in flight, so the pack abandoned its own upgrades as Blocked. The pack now waits for the transactions of connections it closed before opening or deleting again; a node test pins the ordering.
